title: pongamia velutina
intro: Pongamia velutina, commonly known as the Indian beech or Pongam tree, is a species of tree in the Fabaceae family, native to tropical Asia. The health benefits of Pongamia velutina include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antiseptic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Pongamia velutina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
